Director of Product Management — Growth
Notion — San Francisco, CA (Hybrid)

About the Role

Notion is looking for a Director of Product Management to lead our Growth product area. You will own the end-to-end experience for how new users discover value in Notion, from their first login through their first collaborative workspace. This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of product intuition, experimentation, and data-driven decision making.

You will manage a team of 3 PMs and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Marketing to accelerate user activation and long-term retention. You will report directly to our VP of Product.

What You'll Do

- Define and execute the vision and strategy for Notion's user activation and growth funnel
- Build and maintain a high-performing PM team through coaching, goal-setting, and career development
- Partner with Data Science and Analytics to establish north star metrics and drive experimentation at scale
- Own the product roadmap for onboarding, activation, and referral loops
- Drive cross-functional alignment with Marketing and Sales on PLG (product-led growth) initiatives
- Present product strategy and performance reviews to the C-suite quarterly

What We're Looking For

Required:
- 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a growth or PLG-focused role
- Proven track record of shipping products that moved activation or retention metrics
- Experience managing and mentoring PMs
- Strong analytical skills — you are comfortable with SQL, A/B testing, and working directly with data scientists
- Excellent written and verbal communication; you write clear PRDs and present confidently to executives
- Experience at a high-growth B2B or B2C SaaS company

Preferred:
- Experience with product-led growth (PLG) motion and self-serve SaaS
- Familiarity with experimentation platforms (e.g., Amplitude, Optimizely, internal tools)
- MBA or advanced degree in a technical field

About Notion

Notion is building the connected workspace of the future. We believe the best tools empower individuals and teams to do their best work. Over 30 million people use Notion every day. We are a distributed team with hubs in San Francisco, New York, and Dublin.

Compensation: $240,000 – $290,000 base salary + equity + benefits
